s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent lateral knee pain with an intra-articular space-occupying lesion
salient_findings: Recurrent pain localized to the lateral side of the left knee
Intra-articular space-occupying lesion invading the tibial plateau on MRI
Lesion with heterogeneous appearance on T2-weighted images and peripheral rim enhancement on gadolinium-enhanced MRI
key_facts: 30-year-old Asian man
6-month history of recurrent pain
Pain localized to the lateral side of the left knee
Slight tenderness and swelling over the lateral joint line
Unremarkable plain radiographs
Normal routine laboratory tests
1.5 cm intra-articular space-occupying lesion on MRI
Lesion homogeneous and isointense to muscle on T1-weighted images
Lesion heterogeneous with internal specks on T2-weighted images
No satellite lesions identified on gadolinium-enhanced MRI

shortlist.label: Giant cell tumor of bone
shortlist.why_kept: Intra-articular space-occupying lesion with characteristic MRI findings

shortlist.label: Chondroblastoma
shortlist.why_kept: Lesion location and MRI appearance consistent with this rare bone tumor

shortlist.label: Pigmented villonodular synovitis
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent pain and swelling with intra-articular lesion on MRI

shortlist.label: Synovial chondromatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Intra-articular space-occupying lesion with possible cartilaginous origin

shortlist.label: Chondromyxoid fibroma
shortlist.why_kept: Rare bone tumor with potential for intra-articular involvement

raw.rationale: The lesion's location in the epiphysis, homogeneous and isointense appearance to muscle on T1-weighted images, and heterogeneous appearance with internal specks on T2-weighted images are consistent with chondroblastoma, a rare bone tumor that typically affects young adults.

rejected.label: Giant cell tumor of bone
rejected.why: Typically occurs in older adults and has a more aggressive appearance on imaging

rejected.label: Pigmented villonodular synovitis
rejected.why: Usually presents with diffuse synovial involvement and multiple nodules, not a single intra-articular lesion

rejected.label: Synovial chondromatosis
rejected.why: Characterized by multiple small cartilaginous nodules within the joint, not a single large lesion

rejected.label: Chondromyxoid fibroma
rejected.why: Typically has a more variable appearance on imaging and is less common than chondroblastoma in this age group
